title: Can You Really Afford a $1,200 Car Payment? Myth Busted

scenes.text: A $1,200 monthly car payment can break your budget in weeks.
Most people think paying $1,200 a month is fine if they have a high income.
scenes.label: High income = High payment

scenes.text: Financial experts recommend car payments should not exceed 15% of net income; at $1,200, that implies a net income of $8,000/month, which is rare.
scenes.label: 15% income rule

scenes.text: Use the 15% rule to check any car payment before signing.
scenes.label: 15% rule

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.
